title: Motion-Picture Equipment (8-mm Type S) - Model 1 Camera Cartridge - Camera Run Length, Perforation Cutout and End-of-Run Notch
scope: and purpose 1.1 Scope This standard describes the camera run length, perforation cutout notch, and end-of-run notch of film supplied in 8-mm type S model 1 motion-picture film camera cartridges of 15-m and 60-m (50-ft and 200-ft) nominal capacity, and the length of film returned to the customer. 1.2 Purpose The purpose of this standard is to provide a uniform basis for the operation of footage counters in cameras.
